Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Recent MI (3-28 days) (Day 1 is the calendar day of the MI system onset)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's history of MI began at age 55, with no specific date provided for the most recent MI. The patient is 58 years old, implying the MI occurred at least 3 years prior, which exceeds the 28-day window.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: MI is defined based on at least 2 of 3 MI criteria confirmed by: 1) ischemic symptoms ≥30 minutes, 2) cardiac serum marker elevation (creatine kinase (CK) ≥2x upper limit of normal and CK-MB elevated above the upper limit of the laboratory normal) or troponin T, or troponin I elevated at least twice the upper limit of normal, 3) EKG: New Q-waves of ≥0.03 sec and/or 1/3 of QRS complex in ≥2 related EKG leads.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's MI was confirmed by coronary artery bypass grafting, but no explicit documentation of the specific MI criteria (symptoms, serum markers, or EKG findings) is provided.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: TIMI flow 0 or 1 in infarct related artery (IRA)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information is provided about TIMI flow status in the infarct-related artery.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Meets criteria for high risk: EF <50% or site of occlusion is proximal, in left anterior descending (proximal to the second major diagonal branch); large right coronary artery; or circumflex, if supplying large obtuse marginal, and part of inferior wall (i.e., large dominant or co-dominant vessel).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has impaired left ventricular function but no specific EF value or details about the occlusion site are provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Clinical indication for revascularization defined as follows: rest or low-threshold angina after MI; severe inducible ischemia on low level exercise or pharmacological stress testing (ST decreased ≥2 mm or inability to complete stage 1 or achieve 3-4 metabolic equivalents without angina, hypotension, or reversible perfusion defects in multiple territories or decreased wall motion thickening in >2 segments on echocardiogram); left main coronary disease (≥50% stenosis); or triple-vessel disease (3 major epicardial coronaries with >70% stenoses)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient had prior revascularization (CABG) but no explicit mention of current clinical indications for revascularization.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Serious illness such as cancer or pulmonary disease that limits 3-year survival
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of cancer or pulmonary disease is provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Severe renal disease defined as serum creatinine >3.0 mg/dL that markedly increases risk of radiographic contrast
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No serum creatinine value is provided.
No mention of valvular disease is provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: History of anaphylaxis to radiographic contrast
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No history of anaphylaxis to contrast is provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Infarct artery too small (reference segment diameter <2.5 mm), target segment within or beyond extreme tortuosity (>90° angulation), or otherwise technically a poor candidate for PCI
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information about artery size or tortuosity is provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Chronic occlusion of IRA (seen on angiogram obtained before index MI or angiographic evidence of chronicity, e.g., presence of bridging collaterals)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient had CABG, but no details about chronic occlusion or bridging collaterals are provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: NYHA classes III-IV CHF; patients may be treated for acute heart failure complicating MI and rescreened
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No NYHA class is provided, but patient has impaired left ventricular function.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Cardiogenic shock or sustained hypotension: systolic BP <90 mm Hg or cardiac index <2.2 L/min per m^2
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of cardiogenic shock or sustained hypotension is provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: LV aneurysm in the same location as index MI and present before index MI
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has ischemic cardiomyopathy but no mention of LV aneurysm is provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Inability to cooperate with the protocol
Patient refusal or inability to give informed consent
Refusal of patient's physician to allow patient to participate
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of physician refusal is provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Contraindication to anticoagulation during PCI or to routine antiplatelet therapy after stent implantation
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No contraindications to anticoagulation or antiplatelet therapy are mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Qualifying IRA that has been grafted previously; patients with prior CABG may be enrolled if the IRA was not previously grafted
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient had CABG, but no information is provided about whether the IRA was previously grafted.
Patient has ischemic cardiomyopathy, not dilated or hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

Recap: Patient has a history of MI but no recent MI within the 3-28 day window. Inclusion criteria for high-risk features and TIMI flow are unclear. Exclusion criteria for clinical indication for revascularization and IRA grafting are unclear. No evidence of contraindications to the trial.
